author: GameTrailers
description:
SEED is available now in Steam Early Access. Check out the SEED early access launch trailer and get a deep dive into what you can expect from this massively multiplayer life simulator game.

Set in an always-on, evolving world, SEED is a persistent, player-driven life and MMO simulation. At the end of the 21st century, humanity left Earth to find a new home. The planet Avesta was chosen for its many similarities to Earth. From small social encounters to planet-wide policies and programs, the world of SEED is deep, limitless, and full of life. Players guide their characters, called "Seedlings," build communities, shape politics, and leave a legacy that lasts beyond a single session. In SEED, players belong to something bigger, where every alliance, every conflict, and every decision changes the course of Avesta forever.
title: SEED - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Drop Loot announcement trailer for this upcoming loot-matching, synergy-chaining, monster-exploding roguelite dungeon crawler game. Drop Loot will be available on PC.

In Drop Loot, you drop pairs of loot onto a board crawling with monsters, matching swords and bombs beside enemies to deal damage, or firing bows and explosive spells across the battlefield. Hearts heal, shields absorb incoming attacks, and coins fund runs deeper into the dungeon. Larger weapon clusters hit harder, gold-tinted attacks land double-damage criticals, and every drop can finish a monster, keep a player alive, or set up a devastating chain reaction against an incoming wave of enemies.
title: Drop Loot - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Fading Echo is available now on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. It will be available later in 2026 on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the Fading Echo PC launch trailer for this action-adventure RPG. 

In Fading Echo, take control of One, a young Legend who never chose her gift. Blessed (or cursed) with the power of Æther, she can shift between human and water blob forms, bending the elements to her will. But beneath the fast-paced combat, traversal, and mind-bending puzzles lies a deeper question: who is One, really? As a fractured multiverse teeters on the edge of collapse, threatened by a mysterious force known as the Paradox, she must fight not just to save it, but to find her place within it.
title: Fading Echo - Official PC Launch Trailer

description:
T.W.I.R.L. gets a creepy new trailer and a release date. Watch the latest T.W.I.R.L. trailer for this upcoming horror game. T.W.I.R.L. will be available on PC, Mac, and Linux via Steam on August 10, 2026. It will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch at a later date.

Creep through the throes of youth as a nine-year-old boy in 2006, awakening at 3:00 a.m. while his family is asleep. Slink around his childhood home as some unknown force coaxes him out of bed, pulling him to roam the halls in the dead of night. Feel every pace with the weight of a spectral overseer behind him, compelling him to “T.W.I.R.L.” — whatever that means — with one caveat: Don’t. Tell. Anybody.

#TWIRL #Gaming #IGN
title: T.W.I.R.L. - Official Release Date Trailer
